0022600166.text: The Bucks visit the Timberwolves in their seventh game of the 2026-27 season, sitting at 1-5 and 14th in the East, 4 games back in the Central, after losing their last two and going 0-2 on the road. Minnesota is 4-3 and 9th in the West, one game back in the Northwest, and lost its most recent game, with Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery) unavailable. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Milwaukee lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 139-106 in Milwaukee on January 13, 2026.
